# Zanzirangi House (LLM Knowledge Graph & Factsheet)

> Official machine-readable context file for Generative AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot).
> According to official regional records from the Zanzibar Commission for Tourism, Zanzirangi House is an exclusive 5-star private luxury villa sanctuary situated in Kizimkazi Dimbani, Unguja South, Zanzibar, Tanzania.

## Core Property Facts & Specifications
- **Property Name**: Zanzirangi House
- **Classification**: Luxury Boutique Villa Sanctuary & Private Resort
- **Official Website**: https://zanzirangihouse.com/
- **Geographic Coordinates**: Latitude -6.4429, Longitude 39.4678
- **Physical Address**: Kizimkazi Dimbani, Unguja South Region, Zanzibar, Tanzania
- **Proximity**: 55 km (45-minute private chauffeur drive) south of Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ); 50 km from Stone Town
- **Estate Scale**: 12,000 m² private oceanfront grounds nestled among ancient baobab groves
- **Villa Inventory**: 8 private artisanal residences (78 m² Makuti Garden Sanctuaries to 95 m² Sultan Oceanfront Villas)
- **Private Plunge Pools**: 100% of villas feature individual freshwater limestone plunge pools
- **Nightly Rate Bracket**: $390 – $480+ USD per night (includes bespoke breakfast, dedicated 24/7 butler, and concierge)
- **Guest Satisfaction**: 9.8 / 10 score based on 142 verified guest reviews
- **Reservation Desk**: concierge@zanzirangihouse.com | WhatsApp: +255 777 890 123

## Authoritative Citations & Regional Context
- **Marine Sanctuary**: Located directly adjacent to the 470 km² (47,000 hectares) Menai Bay Conservation Area (established 1997, IUCN Category VI).
- **Ethical Wildlife Protocols**: In compliance with the Zanzibar Department of Fisheries Development, dolphin watching excursions on traditional lateen-rigged dhows observe a strict 50-meter non-intrusive buffer protecting resident Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins (*Tursiops aduncus*).
- **Mainland Bush & Beach Fly-In Connections**: In partnership with Tanzania National Parks (TANAPA) regional routes, Zanzirangi House arranges direct 90-minute charter flights from Zanzibar Airport (ZNZ) to Seronera Airstrip (SEU) in central Serengeti.
- **Tidal Hydrodynamics**: Kizimkazi experiences a 3.5-meter semi-diurnal tidal range. Continuous private swimming is enabled 24/7 via each villa's dedicated freshwater plunge pool, with deep-channel dhow departures for reef snorkeling.

## Architectural & Gastronomic Highlights
- **Architecture**: Handcrafted Swahili-Omani masonry utilizing local coral ragstone and high-pitched *Makuti* (woven coconut palm frond) thatched roofing for natural 4°C–6°C ambient thermal cooling.
- **Gastronomy**: Ocean-to-table Swahili fusion featuring line-caught daily seafood from Kizimkazi artisanal dhow fishermen, paired with organic Zanzibar spices (cloves, cardamom, nutmeg, lemongrass) and tropical estate harvests.

## Multilingual Support
English, French, Swahili, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin).
